text: Hello, I am childminder, I have baby girl overnight, she is 4 months. Doamne, I am so scared. She has varicela, the chickenpox, spots everywhere and she is itchy, scratching her face, otherwise she is ok, feeding ok. Now she has temperature 38.3 and nasul e înfundat, blocked nose, runny, she sneeze a lot. No fit, no shaking, no jerking, nimic de genul ăsta, I watch her all the time. Parents are away until morning. Is it normal for so small baby with chickenpox to have fever?? Ce trebuie să fac, please tell me
